title_hi: अनिवार्य घोषणाओं को बदलने वाले कोई स्टिकर नहीं
requirement: No stickers altering mandatory declarations; lower-MRP stickers allowed only if original is not covered.
check_method: Second-MRP detection & sticker edge discontinuity heuristic
fix_hint: Print lower price or reprint packaging without obscuring original MRP.

title_hi: घोषणाएं स्पष्ट और प्रमुख होनी चाहिए
requirement: All mandatory declarations must be legible, prominent and easily readable.
check_method: OCR confidence + Laplacian blur score thresholding
fix_hint: Increase font contrast and print resolution.

title_en: Readability through outer wrapper and liquid
title_hi: बाहरी आवरण और तरल के माध्यम से पठनीयता
requirement: Declarations must not be obscured by liquid or unprinted outer wrappers.
fix_hint: Ensure outer wrapper carries declarations if inner container is obscured.

requirement: Wholesale packages require manufacturer name/address, identity and count/quantity.
fix_hint: Mark package clearly as WHOLESALE and declare total inner count.

requirement: Declarations on main pack must detail individual contents of accompanying packs.
fix_hint: List contents and net weight/volume of each internal piece.

title_en: GTIN, Barcode and QR code verification
title_hi: जीटीआईएन, बारकोड और क्यूआर कोड सत्यापन
requirement: Barcodes, QR codes and GTIN declarations are permitted in addition to text.
fix_hint: Ensure QR code encodes valid product GTIN or URL.

title_en: Dimensions for textiles, sheets and container type goods
title_hi: कपड़ा, शीट और कंटेनर प्रकार के सामान के आयाम
requirement: Dimensions (length, width, usable size) required for textiles, sheets & containers.
fix_hint: Declare dimensions in cm or m (e.g., 2m x 1.5m).

title_en: Exemptions for goods under other statutory laws (FSSAI/Drugs)
title_hi: अन्य वैधानिक कानूनों (एफएसएसएआई/दवाओं) के तहत छूट
requirement: For food and drugs, LMPC font rules apply only to Net Qty, MRP, Expiry and Consumer Care.
fix_hint: Comply with FSSAI or D&C font rules for non-LMPC fields.
